chunks: Whatever is in it from Yahya ibn Abdullah, I have narrated it from Ahmad ibn al-Husayn al-Qattan, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id al-Hamadani, mawla of Banu Hashim, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Ja'far al-Hariri, from Yahya ibn Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Umar ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام.

key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; honorific for a revered figure from the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: from Yahya ibn Abdullah; the narrator from whom these reports are transmitted
key_terms.مَوْلَى بَنِي هَاشِمٍ: freed servant or client of Banu Hashim

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from Yahya ibn Abdullah in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from Yahya ibn Abdullah. It serves as a transmission-chain notice in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih, identifying the intermediaries linking the compiler to Yahya ibn Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Umar ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام.
